name: Autumn Corpus
source:
She was born north of The Capitol, but moved to Syl'anar at the age of 7 with her sister Hazel. Her family owns a ranch and a cafe named the Corpus Cafe, owned by her father who sold the cafe's rights to Nero Inc. when his wife died. The cafe has a strict rule against hiring Elves, marketing it as "human products made by humans for humans".

The ranch is owned by her mother's side of the family, which they have owned since humans took over Syl'anar. It is where Autumn grew up, and she considers it her "home" more than The Capitol.

Her parents had a dream of building their own family-run cafe in the city, but when Autumn was 13, her mother died, whereafter her father buried himself in his work, neglecting his family, thus she considers her maternal grandmother her only 'real' parent.

After her mother died, Autumn changed from private to public school. She never got close to any friends because her grandmother didn't approve of them, so most of her friends she made at church. She never finished college, but did very well. She decided one day that it wasn't for her, choosing to help her family instead by working at the cafe. Before moving into the hotel, she lived with Hazel. Autumn has her own car, and is a big coffee lover. She especially likes the taste of espresso, but remarks it has too much caffeine for her.
